impact.affected_asset: OpenSSL DH static private exponent and secrecy of DH computations using it.
impact.attacker_capability: A co-located attacker able to submit chosen DH public keys and conduct Prime+Probe-style cache timing can recover secret windows adaptively.
impact.security_effect: Disclosure of static Diffie-Hellman secret-exponent/key material through a microarchitectural cache side channel.

causal_trace.summary: A client provides a chosen DH public key to a victim that computes a secret using a static secret exponent; the demonstrated attack also requires a co-located cache observer on DMP-capable hardware.

After a squaring step in six-bit window exponentiation, tmp depends on the secret-prefix hypothesis. A crafted c causes a correct hypothesis to make tmp pointer-like; the DMP converts that loaded data into a prefetch address despite architectural constant-time arithmetic.
During the identified bn_mul_mont_fixed_top squaring operation, DMP activation on pointer-like tmp prefetches a cache-observable target, yielding an oracle for a secret-window guess.
Repeated cache-timing observations accept or reject candidate windows and enable adaptive recovery of the static OpenSSL DH secret key under the stated co-resident threat model.

failure.operation: DMP-mediated prefetch triggered while bn_mul_mont_fixed_top squares tmp in OpenSSL DH window exponentiation

primary_invariant.statement: Secret-dependent or attacker-steered arithmetic intermediates must not become attacker-observable memory-address activity during cryptographic exponentiation.
primary_invariant.violated_because: The DMP attempts dereferences based on loaded pointer-like data, so a secret-prefix-dependent tmp can cause cache-visible prefetching even when architectural control flow and memory addressing follow the constant-time model.

quality.review_notes: The paper, PoCs, victim harness, parameters, and runbook support the mechanism and setup. No raw run log establishes a particular recovery execution, so no test execution is claimed and harness_fit is none_known. Applicability requires co-residency, DMP-capable hardware, cache measurement, and chosen-public-key access; this is not a remote-only key-recovery claim. No upstream OpenSSL source snapshot or OpenSSL remediation patch is bundled; remediation is platform and operational guidance.

remediation.invariant_restored: Prevent DMP data-to-address prefetching, prevent adversarial inputs from creating key-dependent pointer-like intermediates, or deny the co-resident observer cache measurement.
mitigation_classes: disable data memory-dependent prefetching where processor controls support it
input blinding to avoid attacker-controlled key-dependent intermediates
hardware isolation to prevent cache measurement
